subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------COS.ASN.-----ACT.TR.
description: Chart on book p. 332 (R(AS)CM(I)-16). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; COS-ASN and ACT-TR (actual transformation) are the partners in the title. From COS-ASN: ACT-TR, PHY-U-C (physical universe context), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). INFO-DE (information degrees), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from COS-ASN. From ACT-TR: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (D) prefix, "the dynamics of", and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From T-C-IMP: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: PER-TR (perceived transformation). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is on a dotted line from PER-TR.
